newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun mulls Asia TV spinoff - papers.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun mulls Asia TV spinoff - papers.

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd was considering spining off its 16.6 percent-owned broadcaster Asia Television Ltd for a separate listing in Hong Kong in 1998 or 1999, local newspapers said on Friday.
Asia Television is 50.83 percent controlled by Lai Sun chairman Lim Por Yen and 27.5 percent by New World Development Co Ltd, the papers added.
Lai Sun also planned to spinoff its China property projects which are held by subsidiary Lai Fung Holdings Ltd between 1997 and 1998, the papers said.
Lai Sun and New World officials were not available for comment. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
